name: Fixed Partial-Cube Substitution Has Uniform Width Bound
statement: If an isometric outer class $C$ is displayed on $N\geq1$ coordinates and meets both halfspaces of the substituted coordinate, then $\sigma(C\circ_iT)\leq\max\{\max\{N-2,0\},\sigma(T),\sigma(T^{\mathrm c})\}$.
proof: Isometry makes the common section meet every interval between opposite outer sides. Each section lies on $N-1$ coordinates, so every section order, including one beginning with the common part, has width at most $\max\{N-2,0\}$. Apply the exact common-section-first formula and then forget the prefix constraint.
comments: Thus enlarging a test whose two sides are dismantlable cannot create unbounded width in one substitution into a fixed partial cube. This does not bound iterated constructions whose outer dimension grows.
